text: Aldous Huxley's Brave New World was first published in 1932 by Chatto & Windus in London and was banned in Australia that same year. It was also banned in Ireland from 1932 to 1967 over allegations of sexual promiscuity.
meta_description: Brave New World by Aldous Huxley: banned in Australia in 1932 and in Ireland from 1932 to 1967 over allegations of sexual promiscuity.
